description: Global monitoring table for every room. Displaying data from EAM and giving a summary of the status of each room.

panels.description: Single-value query variable that returns the total number of installed AVR rooms (categories: AV-VCR, AV-VIS, AV-MRO), computed from the deepest ancestor of each device position. Use in panel titles as ${rooms_total}.

targets.rawSql:
WITH RECURSIVE
device_positions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.position
  FROM eam_devices d
  WHERE d.position IS NOT NULL
),
climb AS (
  -- seed: all starting positions
  SELECT
    dp.position           AS start_pos,
    p.equipmentno         AS cur_pos,
    p.parentasset         AS parent_pos,
    0                     AS depth,
    ARRAY[p.equipmentno]  AS visited
  FROM device_positions dp
  JOIN eam_positions p ON p.equipmentno = dp.position

  UNION ALL

  -- walk up the parent chain
  SELECT
    c.start_pos,
    p.equipmentno,
    p.parentasset,
    c.depth + 1,
    c.visited || p.equipmentno
  FROM climb c
  JOIN eam_positions p ON p.equipmentno = c.parent_pos
  WHERE c.parent_pos IS NOT NULL
    AND c.depth < 100
    AND NOT p.equipmentno = ANY (c.visited)   -- cycle guard
),
pos_to_room AS (
  -- pick the DEEPEST (farthest) matching ancestor
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.start_pos)
    c.start_pos,
    c.cur_pos AS room_no
  FROM climb c
  JOIN eam_positions rp ON rp.equipmentno = c.cur_pos
  WHERE rp.eqclass = 'AVR'
    AND rp.category IN ('AV-VCR','AV-VIS','AV-MRO')
  ORDER BY c.start_pos, c.depth DESC, c.cur_pos
),
rooms_with_devices AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    room.equipmentno         AS ConferenceRoomNo,
    room.equipmentdesc       AS ConferenceRoom,
    room.category            AS RoomCategory,
    room.commissiondate      AS RoomCommissionDate,
    room.assetstatus_display AS RoomStatus
  FROM pos_to_room pr
  JOIN eam_positions room ON room.equipmentno = pr.room_no
  WHERE room.assetstatus_display = 'Installed'
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    ConferenceRoomNo,
    CONCAT(
      split_part(split_part(ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',1), '/',
      split_part(split_part(ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',2), '-',
      split_part(split_part(ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',3)
    ) AS ConferenceRoomNoFmt,
    ConferenceRoom,
    RoomCategory,
    RoomCommissionDate,
    RoomStatus,
    -- raw parts (X.Y.Z) for natural sorting
    split_part(split_part(ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',1) AS part1_txt,
    split_part(split_part(ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',2) AS part2_txt,
    split_part(split_part(ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',3) AS part3_txt
  FROM rooms_with_devices
  GROUP BY ConferenceRoomNo, ConferenceRoom, RoomCategory, RoomCommissionDate, RoomStatus
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    -- numeric prefixes and alpha suffixes for natural sort
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(part1_txt, '\D.*$', ''), '')::int AS part1_num,
    regexp_replace(part1_txt, '^\d+', '')                    AS part1_suf,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(part2_txt, '\D.*$', ''), '')::int AS part2_num,
    regexp_replace(part2_txt, '^\d+', '')                    AS part2_suf,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(part3_txt, '\D.*$', ''), '')::int AS part3_num,
    regexp_replace(part3_txt, '^\d+', '')                    AS part3_suf
  FROM agg
)
SELECT
  ConferenceRoomNo,
  ConferenceRoomNoFmt,
  ConferenceRoom,
  RoomCategory,
  RoomCommissionDate,
  RoomStatus
FROM ranked
ORDER BY
  part1_num NULLS LAST, part1_suf,
  part2_num NULLS LAST, part2_suf,
  part3_num NULLS LAST, part3_suf,
  ConferenceRoomNo;
